speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Schizophrenia, paranoid type. The 6-week duration of active symptoms (bizarre behavior, fixed delusions of persecution/control) combined with a 3-month prodromal phase of withdrawal and depressed mood, alongside functional decline (job termination), meets the diagnostic criteria for schizophrenia. The absence of substance use, fever, or neurological deficits on our workup rules out organic or substance-induced etiologies. Please continue your antipsychotic medication as prescribed and follow up in two weeks for monitoring.
